items.source: PointInShapeEvaluator can be used to tell if a particular Point is contained by a Polygon or Circle.
items.translation: PointInShapeEvaluator 可用于判断某个 Point 是否包含在 Polygon 或 Circle 中。

items.source: A default PointInShapeEvaluator implementation based on the JDK's java.awt.geom classes.
items.translation: 基于 JDK 的 java.awt.geom 类的默认 PointInShapeEvaluator 实现。

items.source: This package contains support classes for query derivation and other ways of querying couchbase (helper classes).
items.translation: 该包包含用于查询推导及其他 Couchbase 查询方式的支持类（辅助类）。

items.source: This package contains classes related to query derivation and concrete ways of querying couchbase.
items.translation: 该包包含与查询推导相关的类以及查询 Couchbase 的具体方式。

items.source: Utility class to deal with geo/dimensional indexed data and queries.
items.translation: 用于处理地理/维度索引数据及查询的工具类。

items.source: Utils for creating part tree expressions
items.translation: 用于创建零件树表达式的工具

items.source:
Utility class to deal with constructing well formed N1QL queries around Spring Data entities, so that the framework
can use N1QL to find such entities (eg. restrict the bucket search to a particular type).
items.translation: 一个工具类，用于构建围绕 Spring Data 实体的良好形成的 N1QL 查询，以便框架能够使用 N1QL 查找此类实体（例如，将桶搜索限制为特定类型）。
